assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium corporate learning design website hero artwork, standalone raster illustration. Create an exceptionally refined tactile editorial 3D still life illustrating knowledge becoming an interactive learning experience: a fan of printed source sheets on the left, a thoughtfully connected sequence of three substantial paper/resin learning panels leading across to an upright browser-like frame on the right containing only abstract decision tiles and a small check symbol. Make this a deliberate sculptural composition, not a literal diagram or software screenshot. Restrained architectural precision, finely textured matte paper, satin teal resin, crisp deep-navy edges and soft believable contact shadows. Palette grounded in deep navy #12243A, petrol teal #006B70, white #FFFFFF and cool gray #F3F5F7, with tiny muted silver details; no orange/purple/neon. Use a pale cool-gray studio backdrop and a generous clean margin around objects. Landscape 3:2 composition with the entire sculpture in frame, elegant editorial lighting, camera slightly above eye level; strong silhouette visible at small size. No humans, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no labels, no watermark, no robots, no brain imagery, no random floating balls. It must feel commissioned for a thoughtful boutique B2B instructional design and development studio, not generic SaaS clip art. All messaging will be added in HTML.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium wide editorial illustration for a fictional corporate onboarding case study on a B2B learning design website. Show a calm purposeful project handover meeting: a new coordinator at a shared desk and a delivery lead reviewing a concise project brief together, one colleague pointing to a sheet while the other checks a laptop, with one small orderly wall planning board behind them. Two fictional adult professionals with natural anatomy and understated smart casual clothes. Scene conveys clarifying scope, shared ownership, and a deadline, using abstract unlettered marks on the document and planning board, no readable text. Sophisticated textured editorial illustration with precise geometry and subtle dimensional shadows, restrained believable human proportions, clean modern workspace, not childish cartoon or glossy AI stock photography. Strong composition focused on people and the brief, wide landscape 3:2 canvas safe to crop to panoramic 2.6:1 at center while keeping both faces and hands visible. Palette deep navy #12243A, petrol teal #006B70, white and cool neutral gray with natural warm skin tones; a tiny soft warm neutral paper accent is okay. Bright natural window light, crisp contrast, negative space towards outer edges. No branding, no logo, no watermark, no legible lettering, no crowded props, no exaggerated smiles, no handshake cliché. This is explicitly a fictional scenario illustration, not a photograph of our staff or clients.
